{{Quote|The raid on the Republic capital succeeded. My cortosis droids are invincible, and my factories unassailable!|Wat Tambor, following the Confederacy's attack on Coruscant|<ref name="TNDA" />}}
The '''C-B3 cortosis battle droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] similar in design to the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]. The C-B3 was developed by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] to specifically combat [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
Their outer shells were made out of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], a substance that could block [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks. The black outer shell was clamped to the droids' frame in formfitting plates.<ref name="NEGD" /> The droids also had the same intelligence matrix as the similar [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]<ref name="NEGD" />; however, they lacked the gripping hands of the B2 battle droid, since their arms ended in double high-intensity [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The ball joint of the wrist allowed the cannons to swivel in almost any direction. The droids could also use their arms to block lightsaber blades.

There was one weakness to lightsabers in the droids' armor, discovered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="NEGD" /> A very precise overhead slash with a lightsaber targeting the small gap between the two breastplates would slice a cortosis droid's torso in half.<ref name="TNDA" />

==History==
[[File:C-B3.png|thumb|left|200px|C-B3 droid on Metalorn]]
Production began when [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] put two internal teams against each other for the upcoming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] B3 unit. The [[B3 ultra battle droid|Avatar-7]] was selected over the cortosis [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], so the cortosis droids were manufactured as the C-B3.

C-B3 droids were first deployed in limited numbers on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but were used more extensively in the [[Coruscant Insurrection|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the defense of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] foundries on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]].<ref name="TNDA" /> Their deployment showed that they were extremely effective&mdash;''too'' effective, in the eyes of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Believing that they could tip the balance of the war, Darth Sidious, secretly [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, allowed information about the droids' location on Metalorn to reach the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

Production of C-B3 battle droids ended when Anakin Skywalker destroyed the Metalorn factory ten months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="TNDA" />
